summary: The margin condition is exactly a 10-point-gain floor; Jev passed 10.0 by 1.3 points (37.9 vs 26.6 percent), so ~4 rows decide the verdict.
Zero of the 57 none-modal rows had the gold track picked in any order; decided-subset accuracy is 97/199 = 48.7 percent, so abstention-hiding recovery amendments gain nothing.
Summing recorded pickProb across orders instead of the modal key raises A from 97 to 98 with no losses; pickProb and noneProb are recorded but never scored.
Per-order accuracy is flat (94/95/96) and abstains stable (58/56/57): rotation is not a material accuracy tax; flips are hard rows.
Per call ~4,474 chars (~1,118 tokens): option block 96.8 percent, question ~3 percent; a 5-option shortlist would cut input ~68 percent but is a keep-rule amendment.
Jev abstained on 9 of 14 gold-bearing paraphrase probes and was right on 2; the paraphrase gap is dominated by abstention, not mis-selection.
